question: How long and in what form does the ruler remain enthroned?
premises: The ruler stands on the throne.
The ruler remains in an unmanifest form.
The duration extends until the end of a kalpa.
inference: The ruler abides enthroned in unmanifest form for an entire kalpa.
plain_english: O Mother, he stands on the throne in an unmanifest form until the end of the kalpa.
